title: Permanent host loss with pod rescheduling onto another physical machine
message: Local-path PVs pin each Vertica pod to one node; production needs network/replicated CSI storage (EBS; Ceph; Portworx; vSAN) so the StatefulSet pod can restart elsewhere.

title: Kubernetes control-plane high availability
message: kind here has 1 control-plane; production uses 3+ control-plane nodes / managed K8s with an etcd quorum.

title: Zone / rack fault domains
message: Needs real failure domains with topologySpreadConstraints / zone labels; all 'nodes' here share one workstation.

title: Real network partitions, NIC/switch failures and latency between hosts
message: Simulated only by freezing a node container; real Spread heartbeat behaviour needs separate hosts.

title: Production performance and capacity benchmarks
message: All pods share the same CPU; RAM and SSD; numbers are relative; not sizing guidance.

title: Durable communal storage
message: A single MinIO pod on one disk is not durable; production uses S3 or an erasure-coded/replicated on-prem object store with TLS.

title: Off-site / cross-region disaster recovery
message: Requires a second cluster (VerticaReplicator CR or replicated object storage).

title: Metrics-driven autoscaling (VerticaAutoscaler + Prometheus/KEDA) and K8s node autoscaling
message: Needs a cluster autoscaler / cloud capacity; here scaling is triggered by CR changes.

title: Online rolling upgrade between Vertica releases (upgradePolicy: Online)
message: Needs a second; newer image version and production-sized subclusters.

title: Enterprise identity & secrets (LDAP/Kerberos, AWS Secrets Manager / Google Secret Manager, CA-signed certificates, etcd encryption at rest)
message: Requires corporate infrastructure; the lab uses Kubernetes Secrets and operator self-signed certificates.

title: Load balancers / ingress with real external IPs and DNS
message: Lab exposes NodePorts on 127.0.0.1 only.

title: Workload identity for communal storage (IRSA on Amazon EKS)
message: Vertica pods use their service-account JWT; exchanged through the cluster's OIDC provider for temporary S3 credentials; so no static access keys are stored (Vertica docs: IRSA profile authentication). Needs EKS and AWS IAM.

title: Production identity provider for OAuth 2.0 / JWT (Okta, OTDS, or Keycloak in production mode)
message: The lab Keycloak runs in dev mode (in-memory database; HTTP inside the cluster). Production: HTTPS endpoints; a highly available IdP; just-in-time user provisioning and role mapping from token claims.
